sign-in-to: {{name}} is the workspace's name (its brand), or Socio.
provider: {{name}} is a sign-in provider such as Google or GitHub; don't translate it.
send-link: Button: the server sends a one-time sign-in link to the person's Telegram.
form: Screen-reader label of the email and password form.
invite-only: Shown when people can't sign up themselves.
invite-only-reset: The same, when the server can't email a password reset: an admin can send a link to set a new password.
link-sent: After asking for a sign-in link. Telegram is the messaging app; don't translate it.
mock.title: Heading of the development sign-in that lists test accounts. Playful.
mock.continue: Button per test account; {{name}} is the account's name.
link.title: Heading of the page a one-time sign-in link opens. "Socio" is the product name.
link.unasked: For someone who opened a link they didn't ask for.
set-password.title: Heading of the page an invite or reset link opens.
errors.state: After a sign-in with a provider (Google…) that expired or started in another browser.
errors.method-off: That sign-in method is turned off on this server; an operator runs the server.
errors.not-linked: The provider (Google…) didn't confirm the email address of an existing account.
social: Button on the website's sign-in screen; {{name}} is Google or Apple, brand names not to translate.
social-errors.canceled: After the person canceled at Google's or Apple's sign-in.
social-errors.nonce-invalid: After a Google or Apple sign-in on the website that can't be used: too old, used already, or begun in another browser.
social-errors.not-linked: After a Google or Apple sign-in on the website for an account nobody here linked. Links are made in Settings, by a person already signed in.
